product_name: Bajaj Life Assured Wealth Goal Platinum
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan
key_benefits: Guaranteed life cover during the Policy Term (Sum Assured on Death payable to nominee)
Early Guaranteed Payouts (Smart Income option) starting as early as the 1st policy year
Regular Guaranteed Payouts during the Income Period (after the Policy Term)
Enhanced Return of Premium (Enhanced ROP) of 110% of Total Premiums Paid at the end of the Income Period
Option to take Regular Guaranteed Payouts and Enhanced ROP as a discounted lumpsum
Accumulation of Early Guaranteed Payouts (AGP) at a declared interest rate
Death benefit not less than 105% of Total Premiums paid; income/maturity benefits continue to nominee through the Income Period

Bajaj Life New Waiver of Premium Rider
Bajaj Life New Critical Illness Benefit Rider

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (electronic or otherwise).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), nominee receives higher of [80% of Total Premiums Paid minus EGP paid] or surrender value as on date of death; AGP, if any, also paid. Policy must be in force.
key_terms.loan_note: Policy loan available once surrender value is acquired, up to 80% of [surrender value less any AGP]. Current loan interest 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly (benchmarked to G-Sec).
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws as amended from time to time'; GST applicable per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: Guaranteed payouts/income are a percentage of Annualised Premium and depend on the chosen plan option, PT, PPT and income start year — any specific income figure must be option- and parameter-qualified.
Enhanced ROP of 110% of Total Premiums Paid is payable at the END of the Income Period (not at the end of the Policy Term) — timing must be stated correctly.
There is NO life cover during the Income Period (after the Policy Term); only the guaranteed payouts continue. Any 'lifelong cover' claim is false.
Female-life enhancement applies only via a 3-year age set-back; mark-ups (High Premium, Autopay, Loyalty, etc.) are conditional.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'bonus' language — this is a non-participating plan; benefits are guaranteed payouts, not bonuses.
Do NOT position as a market-linked / investment / wealth-creation-via-returns product — it is non-linked and non-participating; returns are fixed guaranteed payouts, not investment growth.
Do NOT imply guaranteed payouts are unconditional — they are guaranteed only if the policy is in force and all due premiums are paid.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan'
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, conditions and exclusions
